verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents business registry lookups, UBO identification, or a KYB flow that chains into KYC on beneficial owners. The only business-related mentions are adjacent: accounts can group a business's history, and Connect shares "KYC/KYB data" between organizations. Neither shows Persona verifying a business itself.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can verify businesses, not just people — registry lookups, UBO identification, and documented KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners
